internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Across all 13 occurrences the root ج و ر does not present one Quran-internal meaning. The data partitions cleanly by derivational form into three lexicalized senses: (1) spatial adjacency / dwelling-alongside — form III yujaAwiru (33:60), the form-VI participle mutajaAwiraAt (13:4, inanimate tracts of land), and the noun jaAr as 'neighbor' (4:36 twice); (2) granting/seeking refuge FROM a named threat — every form IV and the single form X (9:6 istajaAra + >ajir; 23:88 yujiyr / yujaAr; 46:31, 67:28, 72:22, all with min [threat]), plus the noun jaAr as 'protector/guarantor' (8:48, Satan); (3) deviation from the straight way — the form-I participle jaA}ir (16:9), set against qaSd al-sabiyl. The only thing linking senses (1) and (2) is the single noun jaAr reading two ways, and the only account that would also absorb (3) is a vague 'to one's side' abstraction that predicts nothing distinctive. Neither is a demonstrated Quran-internal bridge, so the honest result is unresolved at the root level with the substantive content stated per-class.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: jwr does NOT entail: (a) social 'injustice/tyranny' — the classical jawr sense is Quran-unattested; the one candidate jaA}ir (16:9) qualifies a PATH and contrasts with directness (qaSd), i.e. deviation not oppression; (b) generic 'help/aid' — the refuge sense is always shielding min a specified harm (min 'adhaAb 46:31, 67:28; min Allah 72:22) or a battle safety-guarantee (8:48), never undifferentiated assistance; (c) kinship — 4:36 splits jaAr dhiy al-qurbaa (kin) from jaAr al-junub (stranger), so jaAr itself is neutral to kinship; (d) protection as a universal core — 13:4 mutajaAwiraAt (inanimate plots) is bare contiguity with zero protective content; (e) moral valence — jaA}ir (negative), ajaAra (positive rescue), jaAr and mutajaAwiraAt (neutral); (f) durable/effective adjacency or refuge — 33:60 neighboring is brief (illaA qaliylaa) and 23:88/67:28/72:22 assert no refuge holds against God.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 16:9:6:1 jaA}ir — «وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ قَصْدُ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَمِنْهَا جَآئِرٌ»: a way that swerves off-course, anchored to qaSd al-sabiyl (the straight/direct). It is semantically orthogonal to both populated senses (deviation is neither adjacency nor refuge) and is a single unreinforced occurrence, so it defeats any unified root nucleus. Secondary counterexample to a protection-centric unity: 13:4:4:1 mutajaAwiraAt — inanimate tracts of land merely adjoining, with no protective, social, or moral content, showing adjacency and refuge share no distributed entailment and the sole cross-class link is the one ambiguous nominal jaAr (protector 8:48 vs neighbor 4:36).
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: A single geometric nucleus 'to be/place at the side (flank)': side-by-side tracts (13:4) and jaAr al-junub (4:36) = beside; take-to-one's-flank = shelter (IV/X, 8:48); go-off-to-the-side = deviate (16:9). It is the only account that would lift scope by absorbing all three classes and has a genuine foothold in junub (4:36) and mutajaAwiraAt (13:4). Rejected because (a) it is precisely the vague abstraction that fits everything and makes no narrow, distinctive prediction, violating the narrowness principle; (b) the seam between adjacency and refuge is undemonstrated — no verse states that a jaAr protects or that yujiyr min 'adhaAb is 'putting at one's side'; reducing rescue-from-harm to 'flank' is lexical inference, not Quranic demonstration; (c) it cannot explain the polarity split (neutral 'side' vs pejorative jaA}ir vs positive ajaAra), and the Quran keeps the binyanim rigidly lane-separated (III/VI adjacency; IV/X refuge) with only one blended lexeme, which is better explained as per-form lexicalization than as one live nucleus.

internal_discovery.rationale: All three lenses agree there is no single unified nucleus and that 16:9 jaA}ir is a resistant isolate; two lenses proposed a MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE derivational-family claim for adjacency+refuge, while the adversary showed the adjacency↔refuge bridge rests on a single ambiguous nominal (jaAr 8:48 vs 4:36) and is UNDEMONSTRATED. Adopting the family claim would require either the disfavored 'to one's side' catch-all as the nucleus (rejected by all three) or elevating one clean class over an equally clean co-class. Because (i) the deviation sense (16:9) has no Quran-internal bridge to anything, and (ii) the adjacency↔refuge link is not Quran-internally demonstrated, the contract mandates an unresolved/multi-class result rather than forced unity. The substantive, resolvable content lives at the class level: refuge (IV/X + jaAr 8:48) is internally clean with a distinctive ajaAra+min+harm frame and IV↔X reciprocity (9:6); adjacency (III/VI + jaAr 4:36) is internally clean; deviation (16:9) is a lexicalized singleton. Hence UNRESOLVED_CLASS_ONLY, candidate_root_contribution=null.

Per morphology != semantic identity, the seam is UNDEMONSTRATED, so 8:48 stays in the refuge class without licensing a root-level unification.

resistant_deep_analysis.preliminary_note: Form-I active participle jaA}ir, a single occurrence set explicitly against qaSd al-sabiyl (the direct aim of the path). Neither adjacency nor refuge is derivable from it except via an imposed 'lateral displacement' abstraction that no other occurrence independently attests; its unique pejorative polarity also breaks the neutral/positive senses.
resistant_deep_analysis.reconciliation_rationale: The text supplies only qaSd (direct) ↔ jaA}ir (deviant); 'sideways' is not Quran-internally derivable. The occurrence is a lexicalized deviation isolate and remains resistant, blocking any single nucleus.

independent_verification: All 13 word_refs, forms (N=5, V(III)=1, V(IV)=6, V(X)=1), and verse_texts confirmed against the packet; the three lenses independently converged on no-single-nucleus and on 16:9 as the resistant isolate.

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: 13/13 occurrences read with confirmed QAC morphology: N=5 (13:4 mutajaAwiraAt, 16:9 jaA}ir, 4:36 jaAr x2, 8:48 jaAr), V(III)=1 (33:60 yujaAwiru), V(IV)=6 (23:88 yujiyr+yujaAr, 46:31 yujir, 67:28 yujiyr, 72:22 yujiyra, 9:6 >ajir), V(X)=1 (9:6 istajaAra).
layer_attribution.derivation: Meaning tracks derivational form: III/VI -> adjacency; IV/X -> refuge-from-threat; I active participle -> deviation. This clean form-to-sense partition is itself evidence of per-form lexicalization rather than one productive live nucleus.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: Three lexicalized senses: refuge/sanctuary (IV/X + jaAr 'protector' 8:48), spatial adjacency (III/VI + jaAr 'neighbor' 4:36), deviation (jaA}ir 16:9). jaAr is homonymous across the first two.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: Contextual/narrative colorings (Satan's false guarantee 8:48; threat of expulsion 33:60; rescue from God denied 72:22) are NOT elevated to root meaning; they instantiate, but do not define, the class-level senses.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: Preliminary attempts to unify adjacency+refuge via jaAr (8:48) and to fold 16:9 into a 'to one's side' schema were both withdrawn: the seam is one ambiguous nominal and 'sideways' is not Quran-internally derivable, so the classes remain distinct and the root stays unresolved.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: 16:9 jaA}ir persists as an unbridged deviation isolate (RESISTANT_SEAM), and the adjacency<->refuge bridge remains UNDEMONSTRATED (single-nominal hinge 8:48); per contract this yields an honest multi-class UNRESOLVED result rather than a forced nucleus.

hard_cases.reason: Form-I participle jaA}ir 'deviating', opposed to qaSd al-sabiyl; semantically orthogonal to both adjacency and refuge and unreinforced by any other occurrence, so it defeats any unified root nucleus.

evidence_basis.statement: 16:9 jaA}ir is anchored to qaSd al-sabiyl (the straight) and yields deviation, neither adjacency nor refuge, and stands as a single unreinforced occurrence.

hard_cases.reason: jaAr='protector' is the SAME nominal as neighbor (4:36); it is the sole candidate bridge between the adjacency and refuge classes, and its being a single ambiguous nominal is exactly why the bridge is undemonstrated.

evidence_basis.statement: The only link between adjacency and refuge is the one noun jaAr reading as protector (8:48) vs neighbor (4:36), an ambiguous nominal, not a demonstrated Quran-internal bridge.

hard_cases.reason: mutajaAwiraAt applies to inanimate adjoining tracts of land with zero protective content, showing adjacency and refuge share no distributed entailment and refuting protection-as-core.

evidence_basis.statement: 13:4 mutajaAwiraAt is inanimate bare contiguity with no protective content, so protection cannot be the universal core of the root.

hard_case_representation.rationale: The root persists as multiple form-partitioned classes whose cross-class bridges are not Quran-internally demonstrated: 16:9 deviation is an unbridged isolate (RESISTANT_SEAM), and the adjacency↔refuge link is carried by a single ambiguous nominal (8:48 jaAr) that cannot demonstrate unity. This resistance is genuine and adversarially surfaced, not an artifact of insufficient reading (13/13 covered).

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A Quran-internal bridge that demonstrably unifies the adjacency and refuge classes across the form partition (e.g., a verse where a jaAr/neighbor relation itself enacts refuge, or where yujiyr min [harm] is stated as being-alongside), which would convert the unresolved multi-class partition into a genuine derivational-family nucleus.
rejection_condition.search_location: The jaAr hinge occurrences (4:36:13:3, 4:36:16:3, 8:48:14:1) and the IV/X refuge frame (9:6:5:1, 9:6:6:2, 46:31:11:2), tested against the adjacency forms (33:60:16:1, 13:4:4:1).
rejection_condition.verification_method: Check whether any occurrence co-predicates adjacency and protection of the same referent, or whether the min-[harm] refuge frame is ever glossed by a spatial 'alongside' relation, rather than inferring it from the shared nominal jaAr.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Reject shared-nominal identity (jaAr) and the 'to one's side' abstraction as evidence per morphology != semantic identity and the narrowness principle; require a distinctive, predictive contrast, not a catch-all that fits everything.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If no such bridge is found, the multi-class UNRESOLVED verdict stands and no single root contribution may be asserted; if found, reopen toward a DERIVATIONAL_FAMILY / REPRESENTATIVE claim for adjacency+refuge with 16:9 retained as a resistant isolate.

reopen_conditions: If a verse is shown to co-predicate the neighbor/adjacency relation and the refuge/protection relation of the same referent (beyond the shared nominal jaAr at 4:36 vs 8:48), demonstrating a genuine adjacency->protection bridge, reopen toward a derivational-family claim.

If a second, independent occurrence of the deviation sense (jaA}ir / qaSd-contrast) appears, re-examine whether 16:9 is a lexicalized isolate or a third productive class warranting its own graded account.

If evidence shows the IV/X refuge frame (ajaAra + min + harm) is spatially grounded as 'placing at one's side' rather than 'shielding from a threat', re-test the 'to one's side' nucleus as a distinctive (not catch-all) account.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: No single root-level candidate is asserted (candidate_root_contribution=null), so root-level adversarial falsification is not required. Any attempt to falsify a unified nucleus already fails: 16:9 jaA}ir is orthogonal and unreinforced, and the sole adjacency↔refuge link is a single ambiguous nominal (8:48). Distinctiveness fails for a unified claim because the only unifier is the everything-fitting 'to one's side' abstraction.
